audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phase sides disagreed with the content layer and packet levelChart. Full read Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Skill/Skill/Skill; content and packet read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Naafiri/Naafiri/Orianna.
audit.why: 47.6% over 2624 games: Orianna owns level 1 on range before the pack comes together, levels 2-5 are a genuine chip fight, 6 and first item belong to Naafiri's all-in, and two-plus items return to Orianna's teamfight ultimate.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides aligned to the content layer, with every why rewritten in the same group so each row's sentence matches its verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] and phases[5] whys described Orianna's spikes while both rows belong to Naafiri, and breakdown.spikes said level 6 'doubles your lane presence'.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit is 110/95/80 at 900 range with a recast that grants a shield — that is the level 6 and first-item spike in this lane, not Shockwave. Orianna's own spike is two-plus items and grouped fights.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to Naafiri's all-in with real numbers; breakdown.spikes reframed around surviving to two items.
sources: enemyKit.R cd 110/95/80, range 900, shield on recast

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that The Call of the Pack makes her untargetable, never gives a cooldown for anything, and never explains what killing packmates actually buys you.
audit.why: The Call of the Pack (W, 26/24/22/20/18, 400) makes Naafiri Untargetable while spawning extra packmates — a Shockwave or Command: Attack thrown into that window is spent on nothing. Eviscerate (E, 11/10/9/8/7, 450 dash) recalls her packmates and fully heals them, so packmates you kill with Command: Dissonance only stay dead until her next E. Darkin Daggers (Q, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, 900) is what makes packmates leap onto the first champion it hits, so standing in the minion wave gives them a closer target. Hounds' Pursuit (R, 110/95/80) is a 900-range lock-on dash with a recast that shields her.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and the do/don't bodies now carry the untargetable window, the 450-unit E and the 900-range R.
sources: enemyKit W/E/Q/R text, cooldowns and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — packet reports zero sequencing cues.

audit.corrected: Rewritten with both, plus an explicit 'commit after she dashes' cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: Naafiri is female and the full layer called her he/his throughout — tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, four phase whys, three do/don't titles and report[0]/[1]/[3]/[4]/[8]/[11]. dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d were also foreign strings pasted under their titles.
audit.why: champ-gender lists naafiri as female; the third person on this page is always the enemy.
audit.corrected: Regendered throughout and the three bled bullets rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions feed asks for a Grievous Wounds line on Eviscerate.
audit.why: Riot's text for Eviscerate says it recalls her packmates 'and fully heals them' — the healing named in the kit lands on the packmates, not on Naafiri. I wrote the packmate-reset fact, which is verifiable, and did not assert that anti-heal blunts her personally.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now says packmates you kill stay dead only until Eviscerate recalls them.

notes: Naafiri is female; the full layer was written for a male enemy and every occurrence is regendered above. All seven full-layer chart sides disagreed with the content layer and packet.levelChart — the content layer matched the packet and the whys, so the full sides move to it and every full why is rewritten in the same group. phases[N].rating left untouched deliberately: the rating scale is inconsistent across this data (on mel, Orianna-winning rows carry the higher number; here, Naafiri-winning rows carry the higher number), so I could not tell whether it means difficulty or advantage and the chart rule says leave it. Kit-vs-feed conflict: the needs-antiheal headline claims Eviscerate sustains Naafiri, but Riot's text says it heals her packmates — I wrote the packmate fact only. suspectNames flagged 'Darkin Dagger' in content.mid; the real name is Darkin Daggers, but that string sits in content.mid which I did not otherwise need to rewrite — flagged rather than edited to avoid touching a passage I had no other correction for.
